Mongo gpu_workers cleaned up after helper worker run.
critical_code_review_comments: frasberg_gpu._requeue_stale uses an ISO-string timestamp comparison ($lt) against the created_at string; works today because created_at is always stored with the same tz-aware isoformat, but any future code path inserting with a different formatting (e.g. missing +00:00 offset) would silently skip the TTL. Consider using a BSON Date field for created_at or wrapping with a helper to guarantee the same format at write time.

/api/gpu-admin/notebook validates the gateway with re.match(r'^https://[^\s"\'] +/api/gpu$'), but it accepts any https host (no allowlist). An admin could paste a hostile https URL and bake the FRASBERG_WORKER_SECRET into a notebook sent elsewhere. Low risk because only admins can call it, but consider pinning to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or an env-configured allowlist.
EngineStatus GpuPanel polls /api/gpu-admin/overview every 15s even when the tab is hidden; a visibility-change gate (document.visibilityState==='visible') would save bandwidth.

Studio.jsx: when all engines are offline, the preview banner shows but the first engine card (Motion Free) is not auto-highlighted as the suggested target - the default stays on Motion Fast which is harder for free users. Consider auto-selecting Motion Free as the default when ?engine is not supplied and no engine is online (currently auto-select only triggers when at least one is online).
